propositions: Authors must be guided to name risky runtime mechanisms whose correctness only resolves after a slow codified delivery loop (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning) and to commit to a concrete fast out-of-loop proof before codifying.
Fast proof must be presented as either a local run or a manual probe against the real target, and the documentation must name these two permitted forms explicitly.
Throwaway experiments must be cleaned up with teardown scoped only to resources the experiment created.
The packaged guide reference to T15 and regenerated criterion-pins.json must be current, and hand-authored gate docs must reflect the validated 44 criteria / T1–T15 range.
Registry module docstring and all guidance must remain stack-agnostic, avoiding product-specific Terraform, Docker, or CI/CD platform instruction.
